contexts.text: The abundance of ideas from the angelic Heaven is presented visible as a bright cloud distinguished into molecules; each molecule, which consisted of innumerable things, produced with a Spirit one simple idea...

3. Around the cerebrum, and also within it, and in the cerebellum, and in the spinal marrow, there are spherules, as it were molecules, called the cortical and cineritious substances and glands... These are the initial forms...
